messages.content: Build a GitHub-compatible git forge for make.fun bounty github-core-clone-01
I'll build a complete GitHub-compatible forge implementing REST v3, Git smart HTTP, GraphQL, and MCP endpoints using only Node.js 22 standard library.
messages.thinking: Plan: 1) Create data store, 2) Implement REST API, 3) Add git protocol support, 4) Build GraphQL and MCP layers, 5) Test locally, 6) Submit
